modules.title: Introduction to Pre-colonial Political Systems
modules.html:
The political systems of the Hausa-Fulani, Yoruba, Igbo and Kanem-Borno societies. This section covers introduction to pre-colonial political systems.

Key points

  • The pre-colonial Igbo political system was described as _____ because it lacked a central ruler. — Acephalous.
  • In the pre-colonial Oyo Empire, the council of seven kingmakers was known as the _____. — Oyomesi.
  • Which of the following pre-colonial empires was famous for its 'Female Warriors' or Amazons — Dahomey.
  • The 'Manilla' was a form of _____ used in pre-colonial trade. — currency.
  • Which empire was famous for its 'Moats' and advanced urban planning in pre-colonial Nigeria — Benin Empire.

Worked examples

Q: The pre-colonial Igbo political system was described as _____ because it lacked a central ruler.
A: Acephalous — 'Acephalous' means 'headless'; the Igbo system was decentralized, based on village assemblies and age grades.

Q: In the pre-colonial Oyo Empire, the council of seven kingmakers was known as the _____.
A: Oyomesi — The Oyomesi was a powerful council of seven chiefs led by the Bashorun, responsible for selecting the Alaafin and checking his powers.

quiz.q: The pre-colonial Igbo political system was described as _____ because it lacked a central ruler.
quiz.solution: 'Acephalous' means 'headless'; the Igbo system was decentralized, based on village assemblies and age grades.

quiz.q: In the pre-colonial Oyo Empire, the council of seven kingmakers was known as the _____.
quiz.solution: The Oyomesi was a powerful council of seven chiefs led by the Bashorun, responsible for selecting the Alaafin and checking his powers.

quiz.q: Which of the following pre-colonial empires was famous for its 'Female Warriors' or Amazons?
quiz.solution: The Kingdom of Dahomey maintained an elite all-female military unit known as the Mino (Amazons).

quiz.q: The 'Manilla' was a form of _____ used in pre-colonial trade.
quiz.solution: Manillas were C-shaped metal bracelets (usually brass/copper) used as money in West Africa.

quiz.q: Which empire was famous for its 'Moats' and advanced urban planning in pre-colonial Nigeria?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Benin Empire.

quiz.q: The first political party in Nigeria was:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: NNDP.

quiz.q: The first Nigerian political party, the NNDP, was founded by...
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Herbert Macaulay.

quiz.q: The first political party in Nigeria, NNDP, was founded by:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: Herbert Macaulay.

quiz.q: The Royal Niger Company was granted a charter in 1886 to _____.
options: administer and trade in the Niger territories
quiz.solution: The charter gave George Goldie’s company the power to govern the Niger basin on behalf of Britain until it was revoked in 1900.

quiz.q: The OAU (Organization of African Unity) was founded in 1963 in _____.
quiz.solution: Ethiopia's capital became the permanent home of the OAU, which aimed to promote unity and end colonialism in Africa.

quiz.q: Which empire was destroyed by the British Punitive Expedition of 1897?
quiz.solution: The expedition led to the capture of Oba Ovonramwen and the looting of the famous Benin Bronzes.

quiz.q: The 1929 Aba Women's Riot was a protest against _____.
quiz.solution: Igbo and Ibibio women revolted because they feared the colonial government intended to impose taxes on them.

quiz.q: The 1962/63 census crisis was one of the factors that led to the collapse of the _____.
quiz.solution: Disputes over population figures (used for revenue and seats) weakened the coalition between the NPC and NCNC.

quiz.q: The 'National Youth Service Corps' (NYSC) was established in _____.
quiz.solution: It was created to foster national unity and reconciliation after the Civil War.

quiz.q: The Golden Stool is the symbol of unity for the:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Asante (Ashanti).

quiz.q: Kanem-Borno empire was located around:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Lake Chad.

quiz.q: The Royal Niger Company was granted a charter in:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: 1886.

quiz.q: Ghana Empire was known as the land of:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Gold.

quiz.q: The Aba Women's Riot took place in:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: 1929.

quiz.q: Murtala Muhammed was assassinated in:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: 1976.

quiz.q: Mali Empire reached its peak under:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Mansa Musa.

quiz.q: The Aba Women's Riot was caused by:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Taxation of women.

quiz.q: Oyo Empire's head was:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: Alaafin.

quiz.q: Richards Constitution year:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: 1946.

quiz.q: Mary Slessor stopped:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: Killing of twins.

quiz.q: Interim National Government head:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: Shonekan.

quiz.q: The Royal Niger Company was led by...

quiz.q: The 'Unification Decree' of 1966, which abolished federalism, was issued by...

quiz.q: Jaja of Opobo was a merchant prince in the:

quiz.q: Which currency was used before the Naira?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: Pound Sterling.
